marine.title: Marine

workshop.countryDetected: Found from your time zone, {zone}. The next step suggests what is usual in {country}, and you confirm each one.
workshop.countryChosen: The next step suggests what is usual in {country}, and you confirm each one.
workshop.countryMissing: Choose the country, and the next step suggests its language, currency and date format.
workshop.skip: Use the suggestions and skip to Ready

region.title: Language and region
region.subtitle: Suggested for {country}. Check each one: they decide what your customers read.
region.subtitleNoCountry: Check each one: they decide what your customers read.
region.docLanguageHint: Invoices, quotes, work orders and emails are written in it, whoever in the workshop prints or sends them.
region.ownScreensHint: Each person picks their screen language in their user menu. It never changes what customers get.
region.phoneHint: Added to customer numbers typed without a country code, like +44.
region.forceTitle: Show the customer portal and shared links in {language} too
region.forceHint: Off: a customer who opens a link reads it in their own browser's language. Downloaded and emailed documents are always in {language}.

tax.title: Taxes on your invoices
tax.subtitle: How tax is added and named on what you send.
tax.charges: Do you charge tax on your work?
tax.rateHint: Typed by you. Torqvoice never guesses a tax rate; check it with your accountant.
tax.name: Name on invoices
tax.includingExample: You type {total}. The customer pays {total}, of which {tax} is {label}.
tax.noTax: No tax line is printed, and the total is what you typed.
tax.skippedHint: Skipped for now, so no tax is added. Choose Yes to set it up here, or later in Settings, Tax.
tax.advanced: Two taxes on one invoice, like GST and QST, or tax on parts only? Set that up in Settings, Tax, once the workshop is open.
